One of the 9 hymns that are printed in the Stavamaṇimālā as Sarasvatī Vilāsa Series 6 (ed. Subrahmanya Sastri)
The term 'rasāyana' in the title of the hymn and 'niṣyanada' to signify the parts of the hymn both allude to its value as treatment for the minds of poets (see Sinhā pg. 300)
The hymn describes various exploits, stories, and anecdotes of Rāma (see Sinhā pg. 300)

Although the Paryāyoktiniṣyanda is mentioned as a separate work in New Catalogus Catalogurum (NCC). Vols 1-36: vol. 24, p. 188, Thiruvengadathan states that it is the third niṣyanda of the Rāmakarṇarasāyaṇastava (see Thiruvengadathan, A. Rāmabhadra Dīkṣita and His Works: A Study. Chennai: The Kuppuswami Sastri Research Institute, 2002: p. 163).
